en-US.author: PDF-XChange Co Ltd.
en-US.description: All the features of PDF-XChange Editor Plus, PDF-Tools and PDF-XChange Standard in one economical bundle.
en-US.longDescription:
The PDF-XChange PRO V11 bundle combines three of PDF-XChange's applications:
- PDF-XChange Editor Plus – one of the fastest and most feature-rich applications used worldwide to create, view, edit and annotate PDF files.
- PDF Tools – a dynamic and user-friendly solution for the batch-creation and manipulation of industry-standard PDF and image files. Featuring eighty-eight default tools, as well as the option to clone, edit and create fully-customizable tools, it’s the ideal software to compliment your existing PDF facilities.
- PDF-XChange Standard – our virtual printer that is used to convert industry-standard file formats to PDF. It's compatible with files from almost all Windows applications such as MS Word, Excel and AutoCAD. It features an optimized, hybrid engine that significantly increases the quality of conversion for images and image-based text characters, and prints to both GDI and XPS.
The combination of these products makes it possible to create, view, edit and print PDF files to the highest levels of quality.
en-US.name: PDF-XChange PRO
en-US.releaseNotes:
PDF-XChange Editor
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
- Fixed a very infrequent crash on application close.
- Fixed some security and stability issues. Click here for further information.
- Fixed a possible crash in the 'Recolor Pages' operation when used in 'Remap Colors' mode.
- Applied fixes to the Save Document procedure to avoid adding the 'temporary' attribute to the destination file. This attribute can affect cloud synchronization software, which often skips files with it during synchronization. (49875)
- Fixed display artifacts apparent during page scrolling when the bottom of the page viewport was positioned far beyond the monitor boundaries. (T# 7933).
- A number of fixes have been implemented to resolve complex conflicts between the new file Open/Save dialog box component and cloud file systems (specifically SharePoint). When users attempted to "Check Out" documents opened from SharePoint, a "No permissions" error could sometimes occur.
- Fixed an issue with the 'Copy Selected Text Style' and 'Make Selected Text Style Default' functions, related to copying the color of selected text into the text style settings.
- Fixed a rare issue where the 'Select Folder' dialog box would fail to appear when using the 'Search pane > Where to search > Browse for Folder' feature during remote desktop sessions, or on certain systems.
- Fixed an issue that occurred when there were several editable combo boxes in the Properties pane. When users entered custom values the autocomplete feature could select a similar item from the list—sometimes completely replacing the user input and disrupting the cursor position.
- Improved the rendering of U3D models.
- The application startup time has been reduced in cases where users have many stamp collections and/or those collections are large.
PDF-Tools
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
- Fixed an issue where the 'Delete Pages' action could skip pages when the 'Delete only empty pages' option was enabled.
PDF-XChange Printer Standard
Bug fixes and other updates/enhancements:
- Fixed a possible crash that could happen after showing the Open/Save dialog box in the printer preferences when shown from the modern UI print dialog box.

zh-CN.description: 将 PDF-XChange Editor Plus、PDF-Tools 和 PDF-XChange Standard 的所有功能整合进一个经济实惠的捆绑包中。
zh-CN.longDescription:
PDF-XChange PRO V11 软件包整合了 PDF-XChange 的三款应用程序：
- PDF-XChange Editor Plus —— 全球范围内用于创建、查看、编辑和注释 PDF 文件速度最快、功能最丰富的应用程序之一。此处可获取 PDF-XChange Editor 手册。
- PDF Tools —— 一款动态且用户友好的解决方案，用于批量创建和处理行业标准的 PDF 及图像文件。它内置 88 种默认工具，并支持克隆、编辑和创建完全自定义的工具，是完善您现有 PDF 设施的理想软件。此处可获取 PDF-Tools 用户手册。
- PDF-XChange Standard —— 我们的虚拟打印机，用于将行业标准的文件格式转换为 PDF。它兼容几乎所有 Windows 应用程序（如 MS Word、Excel 和 AutoCAD）的文件。它采用优化的混合引擎，显著提升了图像和基于图像的文字字符的转换质量，并支持打印到 GDI 和 XPS。此处可获取 PDF-XChange Standard 用户手册。
这些产品的结合使得以最高质量水平创建、查看、编辑和打印 PDF 文件成为可能。
